comparison_caveat: Reference LoRA/rank-0 values were produced without N4, i.e. on different model inputs. Treat any delta as descriptive context, not a controlled contrast.

protocol.clicks: click1 uniform GT foreground; click2/3 uniform XOR error; FN positive, FP negative
protocol.geometry: crop to the bounding box of nonzero image voxels, then resize that box to 128^3. The box is derived from image intensity only, NOT from the label, so localization is not oracle and this remains comparable with automatic segmentation methods.
protocol.normalization: source nonzero-voxel population z-score before resize; unchanged by the crop because the crop removes only zero voxels
protocol.target: WT = raw labels {1,2,3}; RC label 4 excluded
